chapter_title: The Chapter of the Three Seasons
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
 of the Three
 Seasons


---


**
¶1.
** From the time when wisdom
 first went
 forth from
 the Divine
 and was con
joined with falsity,
 suffering
 within
 it
, until
 that
 state
 when
 the complete
 Divine Human form
 shall
 rise from the mass of natural things
, and every
 element
 of wisdom
 that
 had
 been imm
ersed in falsity shall be separated
 and
 made
 pure
 —
 from that first
 state to
 that final state
, three great
 states
 of
 spiritual progression
 unf
old.

**¶2.
** Three states: from the time when
 the celest
ial principle
 of the human mind —
 the
 original
 Divine end
owment — descended into the deepest
 states of evil and falsity, and
 w
aged the combat
 of
 temptation against
 the ruling
 love
 of self and
 all
 the false
 persuasions that
 serve
 it. The celest
ial principle prev
ailed, yet
 its derivative
 goods
 and truths remained behind
,
 still
 held
 within
 those
 states
 of evil,
 until
 at
 length every
 one
 of them could
 be rec
laimed,
 and every
 fals
ity subj
ugated,
 so
 that not a
 single evil escaped
 the
 power
 of the Divine working
 through
 that
 principle
.
 A
 great victory over
 the
 h
ells was accomplished
.
 The celest
ial mind
 end
ured imm
ersion in states
 of evil
 and falsity through
 ages
 upon
 ages of
 spiritual
 duration
, until it had
 overcome
,
 and fulfilled all
 that
 the infinite
 Divine order required of
 it.

**¶3.
** Then the Divine
 sent
 forth
 spiritual
 life proce
eding from Divine
 Good.
 This
 spiritual
 infl
ux drew
 the celestial principle up
ward out
 of the combat
 and
 restored
 it to heav
enly states of
 wisdom and
 love
. This
 is the first state:
 from
 the descent of the celestial mind
 into
 the depths
 of fals
ity,
 to
 its
 del
iverance and asc
ent into
 the light
 of
 heaven.


**¶4.** The
 second state begins
 from
 the time when the celestial principle was
 restored.
 The Divine proce
eding as
 spiritual good
, together
 with Divine
 Truth as
 the
 matrix
 of all
 living
 things, came
 forth and
 set
 the
 human
 mind —
 and
 the spiritual world it
 inhab
its — into
 order.
 Divine
 Good as
 origin
 and
 Divine
 Truth as form
ative power together
 arranged
 every
 faculty
,
 every plane
,
 every degree
 of the mind
 according
 to heav
enly correspondence
,
 until all
 things
 were r
ightly disposed
.
 This entire
 work
 of
 ordering and
 formation
 is
 r
eckoned as
 the second state.

**¶
5.** Then
 the Divine revealed
 itself to the natural degree of the mind
. It
 displayed
 its own
 form before
 all the
 aff
ections of the lower
 nature
, and by
 that
 manifest
ation separated
 genuine
 good and
 truth from every
 false persuasion,
 elev
ating what
 was genuine
 toward
 interior
 states and casting
 what was corrupt
 into the
 h
ells below
. But
 from
 the moment the
 Divine form
 was made
 visible
, evil
 rose
 up in violent
 reaction against it. The
 Divine withdrew its open
 manifestation.
 Evil
,
 proce
eding from falsity, then
 shaped
 false
 perceptions in
 the natural mind, and from
 these mal
formed per
ceptions,
 incomplete
 and
 ab
ortive states of spiritual life were generated
.
 Afterwards
, evil
 fash
ioned the
 will
 and the
 understanding in merely
 corpor
eal form
 —
 the natural
 human
,
 out
ward and
 fl
eshly.
 This
 continued
 until Divine
 Truth itself
 was sent
 into
 the natural degree
,
 where
 it accomplished
 all
 that the Divine purpose
 required.
 It
 planted
 in
 the natural
 mind the capacity
 for regeneration —
 the hope
 of return
 —
 and then
 asc
ended again
 to interior and
 celestial states.

**¶
6.** From
 the moment
 when the Divine revealed
 its form to the natural mind
, until the state when
 the complete
 Divine Human shall
 rise from the mass of unre
gen
erate nature
 at
 the end,
 all
 of
 this
 is
 reckoned as the third state.


**¶8.** The
 first
 state —
 the duration
 of the celest
ial mind
's imm
ersion in the
 deep
est evil
 and falsity — end
ures far
 longer than the other two states. Its
 measure
 sur
passes them
 both
, for
 the
 combat
 with the
 h
ells at
 their
 root
 and
 source
 is the
 most
 ard
uous and
 prolong
ed of all spiritual lab
ors.

**¶10.
** *
[
This
 passage
 is fragment
ary and res
ists confident
 translation
 in
 several
 places.]
*
 The
 proport
ions between
 these
 states
 are given
:
 the
 combat exce
eds by
 twenty
-
fold
,
 and
 by
 thirty-fold, the other
 states
 in
 duration and
 intensity
. Those
 who are in
 these
 states will
 receive the fruit
 of their
 per
ceptions —
 the works
 that
 come from true
 understanding
 — and the ages
 and
 generations of
 spiritual
 development
 will
 be gathered
 up
ward from
 the natural
 degree
 toward
 interior
 states.
 This is the measure
 of these
 things
.

**¶11.**
 The third state —
 from
 the moment the
 Divine displayed
 its form until
 the complete
 Divine Human rises
 from the mass of the
 natural — is greater
 in duration than the intermediate state, yet
 it
 does
 not equal the first
. For
 the intermediate state, in
 which Divine
 Good and Divine Truth together
 constructed
 the ordered
 arrangement
 of the mind
 and all
 its degrees
, is shorter than the
 state
 in which the celestial principle
 lab
ored in
 the depths
 of evil.


**¶12.** Great
 beyond
 measure is the first
 state —
 the combat
 of
 the celestial mind in
 the
 depths.
 It end
ures longer than the third
 state, in
 which the
 Divine manif
ests
 its
 form and
 works
 the
 progressive
 pur
ification of wisdom
 from falsity until
 the
 dissolution
 of the old
 order
 and
 the complete
 Divine
 Human asc
ends.
 And
 the
 third state, from
 the Divine
 manifest
ation to
 the dissolution
 of all
 that
 is merely
 natural,
 is itself
 greater
 than the second
 —
 greater
 than
 the period
 in which Divine
 Good and Divine Truth fash
ioned the ordered mind
.


**¶13.** These
 are the three states of the
 Divine work
 that
 unf
old in
 sequence:
 first
 the descent into evil
 and the
 combat of
 temptation;
 then
 the ordering of the mind according to heav
enly form
; then the progressive
 separation
 of wisdom
 from falsity,
 until
 the regener
ate
 human
 is
 complete and rises
 whole
 from the natural
 into
 the eternal
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: From the time when the light came forth and was crucified in the darkness, to the season when the Statue will ascend and the entire light, which was conjoined with the darkness, will be purified and cleansed. From that time on, from that time to the season of the end totals three seasons.

Three seasons: from the time when the First Man went down to the abyss, and waged the war and the struggle against the King of the realms of Darkness and his other powers. He was victorious, while his sons remain behind with them in the worlds [of darkness, mixed] in the [mixture,] until he shall catch all of them [and overcome them. And] he bound them all up, so that not one of them escaped his hand. He won a great victory [over the rulers of the darkness.] The First Man spent human lifetimes and generations in the land of darkness, until he prevailed [over them all. And] he fulfilled the will of the greatness that was commanded of him.

Then they sent the Living Spirit, the Father of Life. He brought the First Man up from the struggle, he brought him up to the land of light. This is the first period, from the descent of the First Man to his ascent.

The second season is from the time when the First Man ascended. The Living Spirit came, and the Mother of Life. They set in order the things of the universe, they set up [the heavens and the earths and all their arrangements.] the Father of Life and the Mother of the living set in order [all the things of] the universe, up to the moment when they go out [and complete the ordering of all. This] it was reckoned to the second season.

[Then, in] the universe [the light was still bound in the darkness.] the Third Ambassador spread [his image over all] that is in the [worlds of the] living; he [displayed his form, and] he separated beauty from all the powers and scooped it up to the heights, he swept the waste to the abyss, and he [cleansed all the mixture.] Now, from the moment when the Ambassador revealed his image he purified the light. Sin spurted up towards him. He hid his image. Sin came [forth] from the darkness. It sculpted the trees and the abortions fell down. Afterwards they sculpted Adam and Eve in the flesh. Until the moment when Jesus was sent and he [came down to the earth,] as he performed there his will. He gave the hope to Adam, and ascended to the heights.
Now, from the time when the Ambassador displayed his image until the season when the Statue will ascend at the end, shall be reckoned to the third season.
[The first season] lasts long in the time that the First Man spent in the world of darkness. It is a very great count of time, more than the (other) two seasons!

This is the third period, from the time when the Ambassador revealed his image until the Statue will ascend from the lump. It again, that time, is greater than the intermediate; but it does not come equal to the time of the First Man. For this intermediate season, in which the Father of Life and the Mother of Life constructed the universe with its orders, is shorter than that of the First Man.

Great is the period of the First Man! It lasts longer than the season in which the Ambassador displayed his image, until the dissolution of the world and the Statue ascends. From the time too when the Ambassador displayed his image, until the dissolution of the universe [is greater than the season] when the Father of Life and the Mother of Life shaped the universe.
These are the [great] three periods of time that occur.
